deviations.what: fnFormatter joins the ComboBox value and key into 'text (key)' (or whichever one is set). A formatter is business logic, so the text is composed in ABAP and bound; the port adds a change wire on the ComboBox to tell the backend when to recompute it, which the original does not need because its formatter re-evaluates on every model change.
The change wire and the composed text are unverified in a running system.
